title: [main] feature 624914 - Refactor depreciation calculation logic to use GetDepreciationCalculationBase for improved clarity and maintainability
summary: Czech Fixed Asset Localization adds an optional checkbox to deduct ending book value from the depreciation base, supporting residual-value treatment under new accounting requirements while preserving existing behavior by default.
key_points: Adds an 'Include Ending Book Value in Depreciation Base' checkbox to Czech Fixed Asset Setup, cleared by default
When enabled, the ending book value is deducted from the depreciation base, but it still acts as the final floor
Respects individual and default ending book values and Ignore Def. Ending Book Value; assets in a tax depreciation group ignore ending book value entirely
Calculate Normal Depreciation in the Base Application gets a new integration event and a shared calculation-base helper
Affects only later calculations; asks for confirmation when the setting is changed interactively
